# Union of Progressive Peoples
The [bold]Union of Progressive Peoples[/bold] (UPP) is a socialist superpower formed in 2108 by Russia, China, Germany and Spain, later joined by Vietnam and other Asian and Eastern European nations, to stand against the [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"] and the [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"]. It is the only great power free of corporate influence, and scorns its rivals as "corporatists".
## The Union - Ruled from Earth by a President, with a Premier leading the state council. Its frontier is run by a Governor-General backed by a naval task force, and each colony has its own mayor. - The UPP fields the largest army on the frontier, but its territory is poor in resources. Colonies ration food, and its naturally habitable worlds are badly overcrowded. - Lagging behind in the space and arms race, it reverse-engineers much of its technology from Weyland-Yutani and other corporations. - The UPP is secretive and fiercely territorial, and outsiders know little of how it works.
## Relations - [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"]: a cold war ever since [bold]Operation Canton[/bold], which the UPP sees as a UA attempt to seize its territory. In the early 2180s, overcrowding has pushed the UPP deeper into the frontier, and standoffs with the Colonial Marines are growing common. - [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"]: a tense cold war over the Outer Rim. Some TWE colonies have defected to the UPP. - [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"]: everything the UPP despises.
## Forces
- [bold]Space Operating Forces[/bold]: the UPP's elite special forces commandos. - [textlink="Naval Infantry" link="CMUGuideLoreOrgUPPNI"]: UPP shocktroops equivalent to the US Colonial Marines. - [bold]Territorial Guard[/bold] (TG): each UPP colony has a complement of UPP Territorial Guard personnel, usually composed of poorly trained part-time 'weekend' soldiers drawn from the colony’s workforce. - [bold]People's Armed Police[/bold] (PaP): internal security and police on UPP colonies. - [bold]Ministry of Space Security[/bold]: the UPP's intelligence agency and secret police, with spies on UPP and UA worlds alike and inside the great corporations.
